room.firstEver.event: The very first room ever: the opening
lines: Hrrk. Well, look at you. A fresh soul, still blinkin'. Don't look at me like that.
I'm your guide. That's all you get to know about me, so don't bother askin'.
You want outta this alley? Everybody does. There's somethin' nicer past it, and you gotta earn it.
This here's act one. Bits of trash. The basics. Basics bite too, so mind the spray.
See that sign? That's the way out. Walk to it, and we'll see what you're made of.
Well, well. A new one. Still fuzzy round the edges, still blinkin'. Hrrk. Don't stare, kid.
Name's... nah. I'm your guide. That's the whole introduction. Don't wear it out askin'.
This alley ain't where you stay. There's somethin' better past it. You gotta earn your way there.
First stretch is the basics. Trash, walls, a door. Spill it all, and the door lights up.
See the sign? That's the door. Walk on over, and let's see what you got.
Hrrk! Oh. You're awake. Fresh soul, fresh fur. Smells like you just got here.
I'm your guide. Not your pal, not your pop. Your guide. Questions? Keep 'em.
Everybody wants outta this alley, kid. There's somethin' nicer on the other side. You earn it.
Act one. Bits of trash. Simple stuff. Ha. You'll see.
That sign there? The way out. Walk to it. Go on. I'm watchin'.

room.backDone.event: The first room of a sitting, with every room solved but not every star won
lines: Hrrk. Well, well. Look who came back down. Told ya I'd remember your face.
You already made it out, kid. Clouds, shiny cans, the whole deal. And here you are.
Missed the trash, huh? Can't blame ya. Up there's clean. Too clean, if you ask me.
Go on, then. Some of these rooms still got stars in 'em. Show me.

room.backAllStars.event: The first room of a sitting, with every room solved at three stars
lines: Hrrk. You again? Every room done. Every star. Nothin' left down here to prove.
And you came back anyway. To an alley. Full of trash. For fun.
...Yeah. I get it. Best trash in the world is the trash you know.
Go on, then. Push somethin' around. I'll watch. Like old times, kid.
New alley. Look it over before you move.
Fresh room. Find the door first, kid.
Eyes first, paws second.
Never been in here. Smells new.
New room. Same old you, kid.
Fresh walls. Fresh trouble.
Haven't seen this one. Take it slow.
New alley, kid. Look before you leap.
Ooh. Somewhere new. Sniff around first.
Unfamiliar room. Don't touch nothin' yet.
Huh. New one. Where's the door, kid?
New room. Breathe in. Stinks. Perfect.
Never seen this mess before. Lovely.
A fresh one. Take a good long look.
New one. Don't rush it, kid. Nobody's waitin'.

room.unsolvedAgain.event: Back in a room you haven't solved; {n} counts the rounds this sitting
lines: This one again. It's still got your number.
Back for more? This room remembers you, kid.
Round {n} with this one. Go slower.
Already beat this one. What, showin' off?
You solved this. Doin' it for fun now?
A rerun, huh? Fine.

room.replayAtPar.event: Replaying a room you solved at par
lines: You've done this one at par. Again.
Par already. Nothin' left here but braggin'.

room.teach.event: A room that teaches something new
lines: Eyes up, kid.
This room's got a lesson in it.
Wait. Look at this one, kid.
There's somethin' here you ain't seen.
New thing in the alley, kid.
Learn it here. You'll need it later.
Okay, kid. Heads up.
This room teaches somethin'.
Huh. Somethin' new in here.
Never a dull alley, kid.
Well, would ya look at that.
Ain't seen that before, have ya?
New one, kid.
Poke it. See what it does.
Hrrk. That's new.
Don't look at me. Figure it out.
Somethin' in here's different, kid.
You'll find it.
New toy in this alley.
Go on. Get acquainted.
Ooh. Fresh trouble.
Your trouble, kid. Not mine.
Look close, kid.
This room ain't like the last one.
A new wrinkle, kid.
Bet it's a sneaky one.
Well, that's different.
Different's good. Usually.
Never seen one of those, huh?
Go on. It won't bite. Probably.
Uh-oh. New stuff.
Mind your paws, kid.
Fresh face in this alley.
Not you, kid. That thing.
Somethin' new, kid.
Everybody learns it the hard way.
Look at that. A new one.
Every alley's got a surprise.
New thing. Don't trust it yet.
Don't trust anything yet, kid.
Ooh, what's that?
Go see, kid. I'll watch.

room.skippedAhead.event: Skipped ahead to a room past your progress
lines: Skippin' ahead? Bold. This one bites, kid.
Jumped the line, huh? Hope you're ready.

room.actFirst.event: The first room of an act
lines: New stretch of alley. Meaner, too. Look sharp.
Fresh act. Same rules. Tougher rooms.
Act one. Bits of trash. The basics.
Basics bite too, kid. Watch the spray.
Here's where it starts. Trash, walls, a door.
Spill every bit of trash. Then the door lights.
Simple. Ha. You'll see.
Act two. Rooms come in threes now, kid.
Same walls, three times. New trouble each time.
New act. Lotta recyclin' boxes in this one.
Hope you like recyclin', kid.
...You will.
Act three. Water, kid. Lots of it.
Raccoons don't swim. Crows don't care.
Wet act. Jugs, sponges, puddles, the works.
Hope you brought a towel.
...You didn't. Nobody does.
Act four. Sticky stuff, kid.
Tar grabs. Magnets grab. Grates swallow.
Hrrk. This act's got magnets in it.
I don't know how they work. Nobody does.
Stay back from 'em. ...Nah. Go on. I'll watch.
Act five. Somebody's whole house got dumped out here.
Cabinets, rugs, a broom. Broken glass. Watch your paws.
Household stuff, kid. Rugs. Panes. Cabinets.
Never trust a cabinet. You don't know what's in it.
...I never know what's in 'em.
Last act, kid. Everything. All of it. At once.
Every bit of trash, every wheel, every bin you met.
Act six. The whole alley, all at once.
And one-way floors. Go the way they say.
...Go on. You know everything I know. Almost.

room.actLast.event: The last room of an act
lines: Last one this act. It's a mean one.
Finish this one, kid, and the act's yours.

room.tiny.event: A room with a small par
lines: Tiny room. Don't you dare overthink it.
Couple of moves, tops. Show me.

room.huge.event: A room with a large par
lines: Big one. Pace yourself, kid.
Long room. Plan the first few moves, then go.

room.hasCouch.event: A room with a couch in it
lines: Ugh. A couch. I hate couches.
That couch again. Nobody likes the couch, kid.
Another couch. Why is it always a couch?
Couch in here. My feathers are standin' up, kid.
That couch is lookin' at me. I hate it.
Couch. Saggy, stinky, smug. I said what I said.

room.hasPane.event: A room with a glass pane in it
lines: Ooh. Glass. Shiny.
A pane! Look at it sparkle, kid.

room.hasSkateboard.event: A room with a skateboard in it
lines: A skateboard! Okay, this room's alright.
That deck again. Best thing in any alley, kid.

meet.bag.event: The first room that has the bag in it
lines: That's a bag. Tear it. Mind where it sprays.
A trash bag. Full of surprises. All of 'em lovely.
Bag. Rip it, and it sprays. Every time.
Ooh, a bag. Smell that? That's treasure, kid.
A bag of goodies. You and me, kid. Same taste.

meet.can.event: The first room that has the can in it
lines: A trash can. Full, too. Careful how you shove it.
A trash can, bag and all. Classic.
Can with a bag in it. Two jobs, one can.

meet.box.event: The first room that has the box in it
lines: A recycling box. Full of junk. Aim it.
Recycling box. Bottles, cans, all of it.
A box full of recycling. Messy when it tips.

meet.wheelie.event: The first room that has the wheelie in it
lines: Wheelie bin. Once it rolls, it rolls.
A wheelie bin! No brakes on those.
Wheelie bin. Shove it and stand back.

meet.jug.event: The first room that has the jug in it
lines: Water jug. Keep your paws dry, kid.
A big water jug. Sloshy.
Jug. Full. Tip it and the floor gets wet.

meet.couch.event: The first room that has the couch in it
lines: A couch. In an alley. Of course.
Ugh. A couch. Lumpy, heavy, and smug.
Couch. Worst thing in any alley. Fight me.
A couch. Every alley's got one. I hate every one.
Couch. Squats there like it owns the place. Hate it.

meet.sponge.event: The first room that has the sponge in it
lines: A sponge. Squishy. Useful, if you're smart.
A sponge. Soaks stuff up. Don't we all.
Sponge. Soft, yellow, smug little thing.

meet.cardboard.event: The first room that has the cardboard in it
lines: Cardboard. Never underestimate cardboard, kid.
Cardboard. The alley's favorite building block.
Flat cardboard. Humble stuff. Respect it.

meet.pane.event: The first room that has the pane in it
lines: A pane of glass. Shiny. Ooh, so shiny.
Glass! Look at it catch the light.
A whole pane. Clean, too. Somebody polished that.

meet.tire.event: The first room that has the tire in it
lines: A tire. Round things roll, kid. Remember that.
An old tire. Bald as a pigeon.
Tire. It'll roll till somethin' stops it.

meet.bicycle.event: The first room that has the bicycle in it
lines: A bike. Nobody's ridin' it. Least of all you.
A bike! Get it away. Get it away from me!
Bikes. Spokes, bells, no warning. Terrifying.

meet.rug.event: The first room that has the rug in it
lines: A rug. Fancy. Don't trip on it.
A rug. Somebody's livin' room, out here.
Rug. Lovely pattern. Smells like a basement.

meet.chair.event: The first room that has the chair in it
lines: An office chair. Wheels on everything these days.
Ooh, an office chair. Spins and everything. Love it.
Office chair! Best seat in the alley.

meet.broom.event: The first room that has the broom in it
lines: A broom. Handy-lookin'. We'll see, kid.
A broom. Somebody gave up sweepin' this alley.
Broom. Long handle. Lotta reach, that.

meet.cabinet.event: The first room that has the cabinet in it
lines: A cabinet. What's in the drawer?
A cabinet. I don't trust it. Never have.
Drawers. Things hide in drawers, kid.

meet.magnet.event: The first room that has the magnet in it
lines: A magnet. Grabby little thing. Watch it.
What is that? It grabs things. Without hands. How?
A magnet. I don't get it. I can't look away.

meet.barrow.event: The first room that has the barrow in it
lines: A wheelbarrow. One wheel. Lotta confidence.
Wheelbarrow. Somebody left their work out here.
A barrow. It scoops stuff up. Handy, kid.

meet.skateboard.event: The first room that has the skateboard in it
lines: A skateboard. Don't get any ideas, kid.
A skateboard! Now we're talkin'. Love these.
Four wheels and a deck. Best thing in the alley.

meet.water.event: The first room that has a canal in it
lines: A canal. Water's for washin' food, not walkin'.
Water. Raccoons wash food in it. Not themselves.
A canal. Wet, cold, and in the way.

meet.tar.event: The first room that has tar in it
lines: Tar. Sticky stuff. Watch what you feed it.
Tar. Black, gooey, and it smells awful.
Tar on the ground. Whatever goes in, stays in.

meet.grease.event: The first room that has grease in it
lines: Grease. Slick. Things slide farther than you think.
Grease on the floor. Slippery as a gull.
Grease. Shove somethin' on it and it goes.

meet.glass.event: The first room that has broken glass in it
lines: Broken glass on the floor. Walk around it.
Broken glass. Sharp. Pretty, but sharp.
Shards on the floor. Paws won't go there.

meet.grate.event: The first room that has the grate in it
lines: A grate. Things fall through grates, kid.
A grate. Down there's somewhere else.
Grate in the floor. Hungry little thing.
Grates. I've made a few problems go away down those.
A grate. Had some trouble once. ...Not anymore.
Grates are handy, kid. For things that need to... leave.

meet.oneway.event: The first room that has a one-way in it
lines: A one-way. Read the arrow. Respect the arrow.
One-way. Goes one way. The arrow way.
An arrow on the ground. It means it, kid.

walk.long.event: A long walk without touching anything
lines: Sightseein'? Them bits of trash ain't gonna spill themselves.
Nice stroll. Now touch somethin', kid.
Lookin' for somethin'? The bits of trash are over there.

walk.loop.event: Walked a loop back to the exact same board
lines: Full circle. Nothin' changed but your mood.
Same board as before. You went nowhere, kid.
Round and round. Board's the same, kid.
Back where you were. Scenic, though.
Back, forth, back, forth. Pick a thought, kid.
Pacin' won't solve it. Look at the door.
Pacin' like a cat. You're a raccoon, kid.
Back and forth. Wearin' a groove in the alley.

walk.exitDark.event: Standing at the dark exit, full ones left; {left} is what is still full, in his words
lines: Door's still dark. You're early, kid.
Not lit yet. Spill it all first, door last.
Dark door. Somethin' in here's still full.
Knock all you want. Opens when the trash is out.
Early bird, huh? Door ain't ready for you.
Not yet, kid. Every last one spilled, then we talk.
Dark door. Still full: {left}.
Not yet, kid. There's still {left}.
Door's waitin' on {left}.

walk.exitDarkAgain.event: Stepped onto the dark exit again in the same room; {left} is what is still full, in his words
lines: Still dark. Standin' on it won't light it.
The door ain't impressed, kid. Spill it all first.
Still dark. Still not happenin'.
You and that door. Cute couple. Still shut.
Again? It ain't gonna feel sorry for you.
Dark. Same as last time you checked.
Still dark. Still {left} to go.
Again? Count 'em: {left}.
Still waitin' on {left}, kid.

walk.exitDarkCart.event: Standing at the dark exit with nothing full: trash riding a cart keeps it dark
lines: Dark door. That trash on wheels still counts, kid.
Nothin' full, still dark. Trash goin' for a ride, huh?
Joyridin' trash don't count as spilled, kid.

walk.exitThenAway.event: Walked to the exit's doorstep, then away
lines: Close. Wrong order, but close.
Right door. Wrong time. Finish up first.

walk.fastRun.event: A fast run of moves with no refusal
lines: Look at you go. Don't get sloppy.
Fast paws. I like it. Keep it clean.
Zoom! Little paws, big hurry.
Fast and clean. Keep it up, kid.

walk.slowThink.event: A long think before every move
lines: Sleepin' on it? Wake me when you move.
Every move a whole meetin'. Fine. Careful's good.
Every step a big decision, huh?
Slow and careful. I'll allow it.

walk.spin.event: Two or more refused presses from one cell
lines: Bonk. Bonk. Still right where you started.
Lotta pushin'. Not a lotta goin', kid.
Nope, and nope. Startin' to sense a pattern?
Pushin' from here ain't workin', huh?
Still standin' there. Still gettin' told no.
There it goes. Now watch where it lands.
First rip. Mind the spray, kid.
One bit of trash, busted. Now it's your mess.
Rip! That's the sound I like.
A bit of trash busted. Fresh mess. Here we go.

tear.beforeLooking.event: The room's first press is a tear
lines: Bustin' bits of trash before you even look? Bold.
Straight to tearin'. No plan. Huh.
Tear first, think later? Brave little bandit.
Rip! Okay. Hope that was the plan.
Thinkin' it over? Good. That's the job.
Look where it'll spray first. Then rip.
Lookin' at that bit of trash. Good. Look harder.
You and that bit of trash. Who blinks first?

tear.stillWinnable.event: A tear, and the board can still be won
lines: Good spray. You can still win this, kid.
Nice. Room's still open. Keep goin'.
That spray's okay. You can still get out.
Spray landed fine. Still winnable, kid.

tear.half.event: Half the full ones spilled; {left} is what is still full, in his words
lines: Halfway. Don't get cocky, that's when it goes.
Halfway there. Other half's harder.
Half done. Halfway's where it gets tricky.
Half done. Half the mess still to come.
Half done. Still full: {left}.
Halfway. Still waitin' on {left}.
Half spilled. Left standin': {left}.

tear.oneLeft.event: One full one left; {left} is what is still full, in his words
lines: One left. Think where that spray's goin'.
Last one. Last chance to aim right.
One more. Make it count.
Last one standin'. Aim it, kid.
Last one: {left}. Make it count.
Just {left} left. Aim it right.
One to go, and it's {left}.
That's the last one. Now get out.
Door's lit. What are you waitin' for?
All torn. Exit's open. Go, kid.
Last one down! Door's lit. Go, go!
That's all of 'em. Exit's waitin', kid.

tear.lastButSealed.event: Last bag torn, but the exit can't be reached
lines: Door's lit. Shame you bricked yourself in.
Exit's open. You can't reach it. Oof.
Lit door, no way to it. Ouch.
All of 'em spilled, and you're boxed in. Oof.

tear.byExit.event: A spray that lands next to the exit
lines: Right by the door! Careful, kid!
Inches from the exit. Aim better.
That landed next to the door! Whoa!
Spray by the exit. Hope it's still clear.

piece.canSheds.event: A can coughs up its bag
lines: Can coughed one up. Now that's two problems.
Bag fell out of the can. Deal with it.
The can spat out a bag. Rude.
One bag out, one empty can. Your move.
Down the grate. That's gone, kid.
Grate ate it. One less thing.
Gone. The grate takes, kid. It don't give.
Clunk. Down it goes. Bye.
Tar's got it now. Hope you didn't need it.
Stuck in tar. Stuck for good.
Stuck. Tar wins again.
Into the tar. That's its home now.
Glass. Hope you weren't plannin' to walk there.
My shiny pane! Ugh. Mind the shards.
Crunch. There goes the shiny.
Shards everywhere. Sad. Pretty, but sad.
A bridge made of garbage. Gorgeous. Disgusting. Gorgeous.
Canal's plugged. Who needs a bridge?
Trash floor. Wet, lumpy, perfect.
Garbage in the water. Path across. Lovely.
Filled it in! Now that's a raccoon bridge.
Look at it go. Somebody's gotta stop that.
Still rollin'. Still rollin'. There.
Whoa. That thing's got places to be.
Long roll! It just kept goin'.
Ha! Passed it on, like a bad rumor.
Bump and go. Nice handoff, kid.
Couch on the move. Mind your back, kid.
Ugh. The couch. Shove it somewhere useful.
The couch moves. Barely. Ugh.
Shove that lump. Shove it hard.

piece.boxTipped.event: The recycling box tips and pours
lines: Box tipped. There goes the recycling.
Whole box out. Hope you aimed that.
Over she goes.
Box down. That's a lot of bottles, kid.
Wheelie's loose! Stand clear, kid.
There goes the wheelie. No brakes on that.
Wheelie bin, runnin' wild!
Rollin' bin! Nobody's steerin' that.
Jug's pourin'. Puddle comin'. Paws up.
Water everywhere. Great. Just great.
Glug, glug, glug. Puddle.
Jug's empty. Floor's wet. Mind your paws.
Tire's rollin'. Round things, kid. Round things.
Round and round. There goes the tire.
Tire's off! Rollin', rollin'...
Chair's rollin'. Hope it stops somewhere useful.
Wheee—ahem. The chair's rollin'.
Look at that chair glide. Gorgeous.
There goes the deck. Where's it stoppin'?
Look at that deck roll. Smooth.
Skateboard's off! Ride it out, little deck.
Wheee! ...What? I'm allowed.
Roll, little deck, roll!
Look at it go. Best thing in the alley.
Click-clack, off it goes.

piece.skateSlop.event: A load slops off the back of the skateboard
lines: Load slid off the back. Sloppy, kid.
Plop. Off the back it goes.
Lost the load. The deck didn't mind.
Scooped it up. Barrow's earnin' its keep.
In the barrow it goes. Neat.
Barrow's got it. One wheel, one job.
Magnet's got it. Grabby thing, that magnet.
It grabbed it! Without touchin'! How?!
I don't like that. I can't stop watchin', though.
Invisible grabbin'. Nope. Nope. ...Do it again.
How does it know? How does it know?!
Drawer's open. Bigger than it looks now.
Drawer's out. I don't like what's in there.
Don't trust a drawer that opens that easy.
Drawer shut. Tidy. I like tidy.
Shut. Good. Keep it that way.
Drawer's closed. I can relax. A little.
It floats.
Bobbin' along. Out in the wet now.
Afloat. That's out of reach now, kid.
We all float down here. Richie! Beep beep!
Greased! Look at it slide.
Wheee. Slippery stuff, that grease.
Slid right across. Didn't even slow down.
Two at once. Efficient.
Two for one. I like the math.
One shove, two things. Thrifty.
Three things, one shove. Domino!
Three in a row! Clack, clack, clack.
Three at once. Look at 'em go.
Four! One shove, four things. Now we're talkin'.
Four at once. Clack, clack, clack, clack!
Four things moved. Somebody's been practicin'.

piece.chain5.event: One press moves five things or more
lines: Five things moved! Okay. I'm impressed.
Five! One push! I'm keepin' that one.
Look at that pileup. Beautiful chaos, kid.

piece.longestRoll.event: The longest roll the raccoon has ever made
lines: Longest roll you've made. Look at that.
New record roll! I'm keepin' track, kid.
That's the farthest yet. Beautiful.
That's the end of the alley. Nothin' past it.
Edge of the room, kid. Turn around.
That's the edge. Alley stops, so do you.
Nothin' out there, kid. Edge of the world.
That's brick, kid. Brick wins every time.
Wall. Still a wall. Always a wall.
You and that wall. Pick a different fight.
Your own mess. It ain't movin' for you.
Trash don't shove, kid. Go around.
That bit of trash needs elbow room. Try another side.
No room to spray that way. Other side.
Where's it supposed to go? Look past it.
Nowhere for it to land. Check behind it.
Not on the door! Never on the door, kid!
The door stays clear. Always. Got it?
Raccoons wash their food, kid. Not their feet.
That's a canal. You don't swim.
That's out in the canal. Let it go.
It's floatin'. Can't reach it. Move on.
Out on the water. Your paws can't get there.
Floatin' stuff stays floatin'. Find somethin' dry.
Can't pour that there. Find some dry ground.
Wrong spot to pour. Look for dry floor.
Broken glass. Your paws say no. So do I.
Shards. No way. Find another path.
Shards! Nope. Not with those paws.
Glass bites, kid. Go around.
Tar's got it. Tar don't give back.
Stuck in tar. Leave it, kid.
Tar holds what it holds, kid.
Gummed up for good. Let it go.
Wrong way down a one-way. Classic rookie.
Read the arrow, kid. Arrow says no.
Arrow points the other way. So should you.
One way means one way. Not yours.

refuse.busy.event: A move pressed while one is still playing
lines: One thing at a time. Even with four paws.
Easy! Let it finish first.

refuse.same3.event: Same refusal, third time in a row
lines: Third time. It ain't learnin', kid.
Three tries. Same answer. Try somethin' new.
Third time's not the charm here, kid.
Third push. Same no. Look around, kid.

refuse.same5.event: Same refusal, fifth time in a row
lines: You think it'll change its mind? It won't.
Five times! It's not movin'. Ever.
Five. It ain't budgin'. Neither's my patience.
Five tries. The answer's still no, kid.

refuse.same8.event: Same refusal, eighth time in a row
lines: Eight. Eight times. I'm turnin' red here, kid.
Eight! Do you hear me squawkin'? Eight!
Eight noes. My head's gonna pop, kid.

refuse.same12.event: Same refusal, twelfth time in a row: the rant, then silence
lines: Okay. Okay. Listen to me, kid.
That. Is. Not. Movin'.
...I need a minute.
Twelve. Twelve times.
I'm countin' 'cause somebody has to.
It won't move. Not from there.
Kid. Kid. Kid.
You know what that is? A no.
Twelve noes. Try literally anything else.
Easy. You're slappin' at everything. Breathe.
Whoa, whoa. Stop. Look first, then push.

refuse.manyInRoom.event: Lots of refusals across the whole room
lines: {n} noes this room. The alley's tellin' you somethin'.
That's {n} refusals, kid. Listen to 'em.
{n} refusals. The walls are winnin', kid.
{n} times the alley said no. Hear it yet?
Took it back. No shame. Nobody's countin'.

undo.losingMove.event: Undid the move that lost the board, straight away
lines: Good catch. That one lost it. Back in business.
Smart undo. You were cooked there, kid.

undo.fine.event: Undid a move that was fine
lines: That one was fine, kid. Trust yourself more.
Nothin' wrong with that move. Your call, though.

undo.redoSame.event: Undid, then made the same move again
lines: Same move again? Bold. Let's see what happens.
Undid it to do it again? Okay.
Took it back, did it again. Huh.
Same move. You just wanted to see it twice?
Third time doin' that. It ain't changin', kid.
Undo, redo, undo, redo. Pick one, kid.
Three times the same move. It's still the same.
Ten times. Same move. My eyes are spinnin'.
Ten! Same move! I'm gettin' dizzy, kid.
Undo, redo, ten times. I need a lie down.
Way back. Good. Sometimes the mistake's early.
Long way back. Fresh look. I like it.
Back a long way. Bold. Good.
Rewound a bunch. Fresh eyes, same room.

undo.notFarEnough.event: Undid not far enough; still lost
lines: Still lost. Further back than that, kid.
Not far enough. Keep goin' back.
Still lost from here, kid. Keep backin' up.
Not yet. Further back.

undo.toStart.event: Undid all the way to the start
lines: Could've just hit restart. But sure, scenic route.
All the way back. Restart's right there, kid.
Undid everything. One move at a time. Patient.

undo.many.event: A lot of undos in one room
lines: {n} undos. Free, sure. Still. Think first.
That's {n} take-backs. Keep 'em comin', I guess.
{n} undos. They're free. Use 'em, kid.
{n} take-backs. Somebody's bein' careful.
Again. Fresh eyes this time, kid.
Fresh start. Nothin' wrong with that.
Restart. Shake it off, kid.
We got all eternity, kid. I'm right here with ya.
Barely even started. Somethin' spook ya?
Out after {n} moves? Huh. Okay.
Quick reset. Didn't like the look of it?
In and out already? Picky. Fine.
All that work, gone. Sometimes that's right.
Long run, wiped. Brave. Or tired.
Back to square one. Bold, kid.

restart.stillWinnable.event: Restart while the board could still be won
lines: You could still win that. But fine. Again.
That board was still good, kid. Your call.
Hmm. That one was still winnable. Fine.

restart.fromLost.event: Restart onto a board that was already lost
lines: Yeah. That one was done. Again.
Good call. That board was lost.
Smart. No savin' that board.
Yep. Start over. That one was cooked.
Again. Try startin' from the door this time.
Restart {n}. Same room. New plan, kid?
Restart {n}. You're stubborn. I respect that.
{n} restarts. Somethin' in here is buggin' you.

restart.sameOpening.event: Same opening moves as the last attempt
lines: Same opening as last time. Expectin' different?
That's last try's start. Change somethin', kid.
Same first moves again. Bold strategy, kid.
Déjà vu. Same start as last time.

lost.event: The board is lost. The line depends on how many times this room has been lost.

lines: Oof. Try again.
Oof. That board's done.
Oof. Again. Somethin' different this time.
Third one. Slow down. Read the room.
Oof. Think from the door this time, kid.
Again. Every one of these teaches you somethin'.
{n} tries. Stubborn. I like stubborn.

lost.step1.event: Still moving on a lost board (ladder step 1)
lines: Kid. Stop. Nobody's gettin' out from here.
Movin' won't fix it. Back it up, kid.
Back it up. Not one. More than that.
Lost it, you did. {n} moves back.

lost.firstEver.event: First lost board ever (said in place of the lost line, that once)
lines: First lost board. Won't be your last.
There it is. Your first lost board. Welcome.
Lost one. First of many. Undo's free, kid.

lost.byWalk.event: The board is lost by a plain walk, with no push or tear
lines: You lost it by walkin'. Walkin', kid!

lost.bagUnreachable.event: Lost because a bag can't be reached now
lines: That bit of trash there? You'll never reach it.

lost.undoneOut.event: Undid out of a lost board
lines: There. Winnable again. Don't do that twice.
Back from the edge. Winnable again. Phew.
Undid out of it. Room's open again. Good.
Starin' won't fix it, kid. Back it up.
It's lost, kid. Undo's right there.
Lookin' won't help. Back it up a few.

lost.yoda.event: Truly stuck: many lost boards in one room, then idle
lines: Hmm. Stuck, you are.
From the door, think. Backward, walk it.
The last bit of trash, first find. Then go.
Take your time. Door ain't goin' anywhere.
No rush. The alley's got nowhere to be.
Thinkin'? Good. Thinkin's free.
Take a look around. I'll wait.
Quiet, huh? I like quiet. Sometimes.
Take all the time you need. We got plenty.
Starin' contest with the trash. Trash is winnin'.
Plannin'? Smart. Them bits of trash ain't goin' anywhere.
Go on, count the bits of trash. I'll wait.
Hmm. Thinkin' face. Okay, I see it.
Mull it over, kid. Mullin's half the job.

idle.second.event: Idle a second time, same room
lines: Still here. Still waitin'. Still bored.
Still thinkin'? I'm growin' feathers here.
Any day now, kid. Any day.
I've counted the bricks. Twice.
Hrrk. Bored. Bored, bored, bored.

idle.doze.event: A very long idle: he dozes off
lines: Zzz... hrrk... five more minutes...
Zzz... mmf... shiny...
Hrrrk... zzz... not the couch... zzz...

idle.wake.event: The first key after he dozed off
lines: Hrrk! I'm up! I was watchin'. Totally.
Wha—! I saw that. I saw all of it.
Hrrk! Who moved? Was it you? Good.

idle.rambleTrash.event: A long idle: he admires the trash
lines: You know what's beautiful? A good pile.
Take-out boxes. Bottle caps. Little paper scraps.
Every piece different. Every piece a little gross.
...Anyway. The bits of trash, kid.
Ever look close at a coffee cup lid?
Little ridges. Little hole. Engineering, kid.
...Anyway. Bits of trash.
Best smell in the alley? Old noodles.
Second best? Old noodles in the rain.
Don't tell me you disagree.

idle.rambleFaces.event: A long idle: crows and faces
lines: Crows remember faces, kid. Yours too.
Still decidin' if I like it.
Bust open a bit of trash. Help me decide.
Crows hold grudges, kid. For years.
Also hold favorites. Same deal.
...Which one are you? Still decidin'.
Got your face memorized yet? Almost.
Stripes. Mask. That look when a push won't go.
Yep. Got it.
Ever notice how shiny a bit of trash gets?
No? Just me?
...Forget it. Push somethin'.
Bottle caps. Foil. Spoons.
You ever seen a really good spoon, kid?
...Forget it. You wouldn't get it.
Somethin' out there's catchin' the light. Look.
...No, really. Look. Pretty, huh?
Okay. Back to work.

idle.rambleRaccoon.event: A long idle: what raccoons are good at
lines: Raccoons. Little bandit masks. Busy little paws.
And yet here you are. Standin' still.
Use the paws, kid.
Raccoons wash their food. Did you know?
Fancy. Real fancy for a bin diver.
Now go dive. Bits of trash, kid.
Those paws can open a latch in the dark.
Can't they open a bit of trash in daylight?
Go on. Prove it.

idle.rambleBags.event: A long idle: the bags just sit there
lines: Bits of trash, just sittin' there. Waitin'.
They don't tear themselves, you know.
I've asked. Nicely.
You hear that? Neither do I.
That's the sound of bits of trash not spillin'.
Lovely sound. Hate it.
Trash, trash, trash.
Full of good stuff, too. Probably noodles.
Somebody oughta open 'em. Hint, hint.

win.perfect.event: At par, no undos, no restarts
lines: No take-backs? Who taught you that? Oh, me.
Perfect. Your guide is mildly impressed.
Par, no undos, no restarts. Flawless, kid.
Clean as a fresh bin. Perfect.
Not one step wasted. Hrrk. Fine. Nice.
Straight line, no do-overs. Show-off.
Par, clean. You make it look easy, kid.
Spotless. Like nobody was ever here.
Par. Clean work. Don't let it go to your head.
Right on par. Textbook, kid. Next.
Par! Not one move wasted.
Par. That's the number. You hit it.
Under par? That's not supposed to happen, kid.
Under par. Under. Par.
I've counted every move in this alley, kid.
Nobody's supposed to beat the numbers. You did.
Hold on. Let me count again.
...Under par. Those little paws found a shortcut.
Raccoons. Nobody gives you enough credit.
You know what raccoons got? Hands, basically.
Clever, grabby, nosy little hands.
And you just used 'em better than the math.
Under par! I'm writin' this down.
Crows remember faces, kid. Yours goes on the wall.
The good wall.
That's not luck. Luck doesn't do that.
That's a raccoon brain, workin' overtime.
I'm tellin' everybody about this one.
Kid. Kid. Look at me.
Under par. You beat the number nobody beats.
...Okay, you can stop lookin' at me now.
Bandit mask, busy paws, and a brain like that?
No wonder you lot get into every bin.
Proud of you. Don't make it weird.
I had a whole speech ready for losin'.
Got nothin' for this. Nobody does this.
...Under par. Huh. Huh!
Raccoons wash their food. Open latches. Remember tricks.
And now? Beat the par. Add it to the list.
Best list in the alley, kid.
Don't move. Let me look at this board.
Every bit of trash. Fewer moves than the number says.
You're a marvel, kid. A stripey little marvel.
A few extra steps. Out's out. Good, kid.
Little over par. Still out. Still good.
Few moves over. Next time, maybe par.
Ugly, but out. Ugly still counts.
Took the long way. Door don't care.
Long way 'round. Still a win.
Lotta moves. One exit. It counts.
{n} take-backs. We got all the time in the world.
{n} undos, one exit. No clock in here, kid.
{n} take-backs. Take as many as you need.
Restart number {n}, and out. I'll allow it.
{n} restarts, one exit. Worth it.
Took {n} goes. Out's out, kid.
Better than last time. I noticed. Don't tell.
New best. Fewer moves than ever.
Your paws know this room now.
I like watchin' that happen.
You beat yourself. The hardest one to beat.
...Okay, the second hardest. Walls are first.
Look at that number drop.
Raccoons get better every time they open a bin.
You're doin' the raccoon thing, kid.
Better than your best. Write that on a can.
I'd write it myself. Beaks are bad with pens.
New record. Mine to remember, kid.
Crows keep score. I keep yours.
And yours just went up.
Sharper than last time. Quicker paws. Cleaner moves.
That's not luck. That's you learnin'.
Keep doin' that. I'll keep noticin'.

win.afterLost.event: After losing the board earlier in the attempt
lines: Lost it earlier. Walked out anyway. Not bad.
Lost it, undid it, won it. That's the way.
Board went bad, you fixed it. Nice work, kid.

win.firstTry.event: Won a room on the first attempt
lines: First try? Huh. Luck, or brains?
One go. Out. Don't get used to it.
First go, out the door. Show-off.
One shot, one exit. Not bad at all.
First try. Okay. I'm tellin' every crow I know.
First go? No restarts? No do-overs?
...Who taught you that? Oh, right. Me.
Clean out the gate. That's a rare one, kid.
First try. I ain't impressed. ...Okay. I'm impressed.
One shot. Straight out.
I'm gonna remember this one, kid. Crows remember.
First try. That's a real shiny, kid.

win.nemesis.event: Won a room after its board was lost five times or more this sitting
lines: You beat it. That room. Finally.
I'm not cryin'. Got trash in my eye.
That one. That one had your number.
Not anymore, kid.
Finally. I was startin' to hate that room for ya.
All them lost boards, and you kept comin' back.
That's stubborn. Good stubborn.
You and that room. It's over now. You won.
Look at that. You got it.
Gimme a sec, kid. Just... gimme a sec.

win.starUp.event: A replay earned the room more stars
lines: More stars. Worth the rerun, huh?
Cleaner this time. See? Practice.
More stars. Look at 'em shine.
Crows like shiny, kid. You know that.
Bring me more of those.
Came back and did it better. That's a raccoon thing.
You lot never leave a bin half-checked.
Good. Neither do I.
Another star. You know what that means?
Means you're gettin' good at this.
Don't let it show.
Stars go up, kid. That's how it works.
Every one's another step outta this alley.
Keep climbin'.
Shinier than last time. I noticed.
Crows notice shiny. Crows notice raccoons who try.
...Both. I noticed both.
Rerun, and more stars. Look at those paws work.
Little bandit hands, pullin' off a better run.
Okay. I'm a fan. Quietly.

win.cameBack.event: Won a room you once walked away from
lines: Told ya it'd keep. Look who came back.
Look who came back.
This room's been waitin'. So've I, kinda.
And you beat it. Nice.
You walked away from this one once.
Raccoons always come back to a good bin.
And look at that. Solved.
Hrrk! You came back for it.
Walkin' away and comin' back? That takes guts.
Room's done. Who's laughin' now?
Remember this one? It remembers you.
Crows remember too. I remember you leavin'.
Now I'll remember you winnin'.
Unfinished business. Finished.
Raccoons don't let a lid stay shut, huh?
Proud of you, kid. Don't quote me.
Told ya it'd keep.
Same bits of trash, same walls, smarter raccoon.
That's the whole trick, kid. Come back smarter.

win.streak.event: Won {n} rooms in a row at par, from three on
lines: {n} at par, back to back. Who are you?
{n} at par, in a row.
Who are you, and what'd you do with the kid?
That's {n} in a row. At par. Every one.
The alley's runnin' outta ways to stop you.
{n} straight! Stripes, mask, and a hot streak.
Don't look at me. Keep it goin'.
{n} par rooms in a row, kid.
I've stopped grumblin'. Notice that?
...Don't get used to it.
{n} in a row. I'm countin', you know.
Crows count. Crows remember.
This streak? Framed. In my head.
Another one at par. That's {n}.
Busy paws, sharp eyes. Raccoon at work.
Somebody stop this kid. Not me, though.
That's an act. Not bad, kid. Not bad.
Whole act done. I'm almost proud.
Act's finished. One step closer, kid.
Walkin' away? It'll still be here. Trust me.
Leavin' it? It'll keep. Rooms always keep.
Fine. Go. It'll be here, starin' at the door.

progress.loseStreak3.event: Three rooms in a row left unsolved
lines: Rough patch. Happens. Pick one and finish it.
Three left behind. That's okay. They'll keep.
Rough run, kid. Breathe. Then pick one.

progress.rooms10.event: Every tenth room done; {n} is the rooms done
lines: {n} rooms. You're gettin' the hang of it.
{n} rooms. Look at you go, kid.
That's {n}. I'm countin', even if you ain't.
{n} down. Crows count good, kid.
{n} rooms! That's a lotta bits of trash.
Another ten. {n} now. Not bad for a raccoon.

progress.halfAct.event: Half of an act's rooms done
lines: Half this act done. Other half's meaner.

progress.skipped.event: One of his lines was skipped
lines: Fine. Didn't wanna talk anyway.
Rude. Accurate, but rude.
Okay, okay. Skip the crow.

progress.quieter.event: Skips have made him one setting quieter
lines: Okay. I'll just watch, then.
Got it. Beak shut.
Fine. Quiet crow. Watch this.
Message received. I'll be over here.
Not a talker, huh? Me neither. ...Mostly.
Not bad for a fresh soul. Not good, either.
Act one, done. You're less hopeless than you looked.
First act down. The easy one, kid.
Two acts down. Don't wall yourself in now.
Two acts. Your paws are learnin', kid.
Act two's done. That one had teeth.
You're almost good at this. Almost.
Don't get sentimental on me, kid. Not yet.
Look at you. A real trash professional.
Not far now, kid. Don't trip at the finish.
That's raccoon heaven, kid. Clouds. Cans that shine. Every lid already off. Go on.
They're waitin' on you up there. Don't keep 'em waitin' on my account.
...You did good. Real good. Don't tell nobody I said it, or I'll deny it.
I'll remember your face, kid. Crows always do. That's a promise, not a threat.
Look at that. Clouds, all the way up. And the cans, kid. Look at the cans.
You earned every one of 'em. Every bit of trash, every shove, every dumb wall you pushed on.
I'll miss you. You were a good egg. A weird, stripey, stubborn egg.
Go on, then. Before I get somethin' in my eye.
So this is it. Raccoon heaven. Smells like a good dumpster, and I mean that kindly.
When you showed up, you couldn't find a door with both paws. Now look at you.
I'll remember your face. Crows don't forget a face, and I won't forget yours.
Go on, kid. Your guide's done guidin'. ...Go, before I change my mind.
